mission_08: Normalize each adjacency matrix before GNN encoding: add self-loops, compute degree, and apply D^(-1/2) * A * D^(-1/2)
For the GRU update: concatenate H_prev and H_curr, then apply sigmoid for gates. The update gate z controls how much of the previous state to keep
Temporal attention: compute scores as sum(H_snapshots[t] @ W_attn) for each t, then softmax. The final representation is the weighted sum of all snapshots
